name: Measurement-Gated Learning Admission
summary: Admit learning variants only after an exact verified predecessor and comparable measurements, retaining immutable receipts and bounded backlog controls.
problem: A published or equivalent baseline can be mistaken for a measured baseline, allowing unsupported experiments or duplicate content into supply.
coreOutcomes: Verified effect equivalence with stable lineage
Comparable baseline measurement as a separate gate
Explicit safe deferral and exclusion reasons
requirements: Frozen editorial identity and publication receipts
Metrics with age, exposure and availability semantics
Existing admission pressure and resource policy
boundaries: Missing or low-exposure metrics are not zero performance
Equivalent publication does not prove comparable measurement
Sidecars do not rewrite original receipts
A safety ceiling is not a throughput target
